# Teams SDK - Documentation Technique (offline, all languages)

> Offline edition combining the C# (.NET), TypeScript and Python editions of the Teams SDK docs
> (from https://microsoft.github.io/teams-sdk/llms_docs/llms_csharp.txt, llms_typescript.txt, llms_python.txt + full content).
> Every feature lives in its own file under `docs/<language>/<category>/`; all cross-references are relative links inside this repo — no external fetching needed.
